'''Battle sense''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that could be bestowed upon an individual after several [[Standard year/Legends|months]] of attunement to a [[Opal crystal|opal]] [[tasar crystal]]. Battle sense allowed an individual to gain an edge at the start of combat and take initiative in a fight.<ref name="J15" />
